title: Low Quality Look To Graphics
text: Low Quality Look To Graphics. The print on this cup isn’t the best quality. It is a little fuzzy, like it a low quality image that has been enlarged too far. The seam is practically invisible. The fell of the cup in the hand is nice. The kid dips downward, which makes drinking from it very much like there isn’t a lid. The edges are thick, so there is that. It is a cute cup. I just wish the graphics didn’t look so low quality. I don’t know if it was an intentional design decision or an accident, but either way, I’m not a fan of the end result.

product_metadata.title: Insulated Stainless Steel Stemless Glass Tumbler by Studio Oh! - Pete the Penguin - 12-Ounce Double-Wall Construction with Full-Color Artwork & Spill-Resistant Drink-Through Lid
features: Our chic stemless insulated glass keeps your drink perfectly chilled or warm for hours.
This insulated tumbler's unique artwork makes it a conversation piece, perfect for parties.
A double-walled design and rubber bottom means this wine glass doesn't sweat and doesn't need a coaster.
This durable wine accessory comes in a matte finish with a drip-resistant drink-through lid.
Each BPA-free stainless steel stemless wine tumbler holds 12 oz. and measures 4.75" tall.
description: Superb for your favorite wine, coffee, or tea, our sturdy double-walled Stemless Wine Glass never sweats and is specially insulated to keep your drink at an ideal temperature, no matter the weather. Better still, it features fun original Studio Oh! artwork. This BPA-free stainless-steel wine tumbler measures 4.75" tall and holds 12 oz. of your favorite red or white. This glass is finished with a rubber bottom, so it doesn't even need a coaster. Make this chic wine tumbler part of your home decor in time for your next soiree. The tumbler is hand wash only.
